# Types reference

Every response model (pydantic, subclasses of `ultrarouter.BaseModel`) and request shape
(`TypedDict`) in `ultrarouter.types`. Response models keep unknown fields; enumerated
response values are typed `str` with the known values listed. See [Typing](typing.md).

### Artifact

*response model*

An artifact (metadata only — bodies are stored separately, never here).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `archetype` | `str` | yes | The artifact archetype (closed vocabulary).  Known values: ``forecast``, ``recommendation``, ``draft``, ``extraction``, ``answer``, ``action``. |
| `artifact_type_version_id` | `str \| None` | yes |  |
| `call_type_id` | `str \| None` | yes |  |
| `claims` | `list[ArtifactClaim]` | yes | The artifact’s ACTIVE claims (one per claim_key) + their current claim state. `claim_key` on an outcome resolves to these. |
| `created_at` | `str` | yes |  |
| `current_version` | `int` | yes | The artifact’s current (max) version. |
| `exposure_arm` | `str \| None` | yes |  |
| `exposure_epoch` | `int \| None` | yes |  |
| `grant_attestation` | `str \| None` | yes | The customer attestation `served` \| `applied` (null when no grant). |
| `grant_id` | `str \| None` | yes | The exposure grant this artifact carries (null when unarmed/observation-only). |
| `id` | `str` | yes |  |
| `key` | `str` | yes |  |
| `lifecycle` | `str` | yes |  |
| `object` | `str` | yes | Known values: ``artifact``. |
| `occurred_at` | `str` | yes |  |
| `request_ids` | `list[str]` | yes | The ACTIVE request memberships (assembly lineage). |
| `situation_key` | `str \| None` | yes |  |
| `superseded_claims` | `list[ArtifactClaim]` | yes | History: platform-extracted claims a later declared claim superseded for the same claim_key — kept (state `superseded`) and linked through `superseded_by_claim_id`, never deleted; their outcome events stay on them. Usually empty. |
| `updated_at` | `str` | yes |  |

### ArtifactClaim

*response model*

A claim on an artifact (metadata only).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `artifact_version` | `int` | yes |  |
| `claim_key` | `str` | yes |  |
| `claim_type` | `str` | yes |  |
| `created_at` | `str` | yes |  |
| `id` | `str` | yes |  |
| `provenance` | `str` | yes | Who asserted the claim: `declared` = yours (declared claims always win their claim_key); `extracted` = the platform’s claim extractor.  Known values: ``declared``, ``extracted``. |
| `qualification` | `str` | yes | The trust label: `declared` for a declared claim; for an extracted claim, the extractor’s verdict at extraction (`unqualified` never feeds learning).  Known values: ``declared``, ``qualified``, ``unqualified``. |
| `resolves_by` | `str \| None` | yes |  |
| `state` | `str` | yes | The current claim state (derived from the claim’s outcome events). `superseded` is terminal: a later customer-declared claim took this claim’s claim_key (only ever listed under `superseded_claims`).  Known values: ``pending``, ``overdue``, ``resolved``, ``censored``, ``voided``, ``disputed``, ``superseded``. |
| `state_version` | `int` | yes |  |
| `stated_confidence` | `float \| None` | yes |  |
| `superseded_at` | `str \| None` | yes | When a later declared claim superseded this one (null for an active claim). |
| `superseded_by_claim_id` | `str \| None` | yes | The declared claim that superseded this one (null for an active claim). |

### ArtifactCreateParams

*request shape (TypedDict)*

Create or upsert an artifact by key.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `archetype` | `Literal['forecast', 'recommendation', 'draft', 'extraction', 'answer', 'action']` | no | Defaults to `answer` when omitted. |
| `artifact_type` | `str` | no | A registered artifact-type name — its current objective version is pinned. |
| `attestation` | `Literal['served', 'applied']` | no | CUSTOMER attestation (`served` = the grant was issued; `applied` = the recommended module/model was actually used). Defaults to `served`. Shown beside lift, NEVER provenance. |
| `claims` | `list[ClaimParams]` | no | Declared claims. |
| `grant_id` | `str` | no | An exposure GRANT from `POST /v1/flywheel/grants`. When present + VALID, the artifact is stamped with the GRANT’s arm (a non-proxied call becomes armed — for granted artifacts only). Absent ⇒ `unarmed_observation`. An unknown grant is a 400 (fail closed). |
| `key` | `Required[str]` | no | The canonical artifact alias (unique per workspace). |
| `occurred_at` | `str` | no | When the artifact was created in the customer world (ISO-8601; defaults to now). |
| `request_ids` | `list[str]` | no | The requests this artifact is assembled from (declared, post-hoc; assembly_source=api). |
| `situation_facets` | `dict[str, Any]` | no | Declared situation facets (customer-declared; hashed into the situation key). |

### ArtifactObjective

*response model*

What “it worked” means for this artifact type — the ONE thing never inferred.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `alternatives` | `list[str] \| None` | no | Named alternatives for computable comparisons (`alternative_id`). |
| `direction` | `str` | yes | Which direction is good (e.g. `true_is_good`, `higher_is_better`). |
| `metric` | `str` | yes | The objective metric (closed vocabulary).  Known values: ``claim_resolution``, ``oracle_delta``, ``correction_rate``, ``acceptance_rate``, ``engagement_rate``, ``task_success``. |
| `predicate_id` | `str \| None` | no | An optional machine predicate over the resolution (closed set).  Known values: ``equals``, ``within_tolerance``, ``ge``, ``le``, ``resolved_by_source``. |
| `resolution_criteria` | `str` | yes | How the objective resolves — REDACTED free text, never a body. |
| `source` | `str` | yes | Where the resolving signal comes from (e.g. `analyst`, `filing`, an oracle name). |
| `unit` | `str` | yes | The unit the metric is measured in (e.g. `boolean`, `ratio`, `usd`). |
| `window` | `str` | yes | The resolution window as an ISO-8601 DURATION (e.g. `P12M`), never an instant. |

### BatchOutcomeParams

*request shape (TypedDict)*

A batch outcome keyed by request_id | artifact_id | artifact_key.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `alternative_id` | `str` | no | A computable-comparison alternative id. |
| `artifact_id` | `str` | no | Target an artifact by id. |
| `artifact_key` | `str` | no | Target an artifact by its canonical key. |
| `artifact_version` | `int` | no | The pinned artifact version (defaults to the artifact’s current version). |

| `claim_id` | `str` | no | Target a specific claim by id (else the artifact). |
| `claim_key` | `str` | no | Target a claim by its customer key — the key’s ACTIVE claim (else the artifact). |
| `confidence` | `float` | no | An optional confidence ∈ (0,1). |
| `evidence_hash` | `str` | no | A content hash of supporting evidence (never a body). |
| `kind` | `Required[str]` | no | The channel `kind` (a closed vocabulary per channel). |

| `request_id` | `str` | no | Target via the request shortcut (one-request artifact). |

| `supersedes_event_id` | `str` | no | The event this one supersedes. |
| `tool_error_class` | `Literal['model', 'infra', 'unclassified']` | no | For mechanical:tool_error — refines learning_use (only model-class teaches). |
| `value` | `dict[str, Any]` | no | The typed numeric/diff-stats payload — never a body. |

The umbrella admission checks arms + this bound against max_cost, so an unaffordable judge phase is refused at the trigger (judge_phase_unaffordable) before any arm spend. |

| `unique_count` | `int` | yes | The PINNED item count driving the tier + runnability: card.item_count (post-cap) — exactly the items the run executes. Equals the frozen unique count when uncapped; a max_items cap makes it the smaller pinned count so the tier reflects what actually runs. |
| `unmatched_candidates` | `list[str] \| None` | no | EXPLICIT candidate ids that matched an offer globally but were NOT challengers for THIS call type (e.g. they resolve to the incumbent here) — a partial match is legal but VISIBLE. A fully-unmatched id is a 400 at the trigger, never a silent drop. |

### BenchRunParams

*request shape (TypedDict)*

ultrarouter Bench on-demand run trigger request.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `baseline_run_id` | `str` | no | The baseline run (`br_*`) to compare against; defaults to the suite’s pinned baseline. |
| `call_types` | `list[str]` | no | Restrict the fan-out to these frozen call-type ids (default: every runnable one). |
| `candidates` | `list[str]` | no | Explicit challenger model ids (default: auto-selected from the catalog). |
| `compare` | `bool` | no | COMPARE mode: run the CURRENT effective config as the single arm (the "candidate": the new prompt/pin/config) and gate it against a pinned baseline run — `candidates` are ignored. |
| `cost_ceiling_usd` | `float` | no | Absolute per-unit measured-cost ceiling (USD) — a breach FAILS the gate independent of quality. Omit for no ceiling. |
| `dry_run` | `bool` | no | When true: return the estimate + dispositions + allowance with NO reservation/dispatch. When false (default) and the paid-dispatch kill switch is ON, a real paired run is dispatched; when that kill switch is OFF (or unseeded ⇒ fail-closed), otherwise-valid paid shapes are labeled not_runnable/atomic_spend_guard_unavailable instead. |
| `force` | `bool` | no | Bench-only: skip the <14 d RunSpec-hash dedupe and always run fresh (audited). |
| `max_cost_usd` | `Required[float]` | no | MANDATORY global umbrella reservation ceiling in USD across all accepted child runs. Live paid dispatch is gated by the platform paid-dispatch kill switch (default ON): when ON, omitting dry_run dispatches a real paired run within this ceiling; when OFF (or unseeded ⇒ fail-closed) live dispatch is refused with atomic_spend_guard_unavailable. dry_run always works. |
| `max_output_tokens` | `int` | no | Finite per-attempt output-token ceiling, pinned into the immutable RunSpec and used as the output component of reservation math (default 256; changing it is a new measurement epoch). It does not by itself bound provider input accounting or replace the atomic attempt guard. |
| `mode` | `Literal['request', 'task']` | no | Paired-runner mode: `request` (default) or `task` (whole-trace, only evidence that may claim $/task). |
| `require_power` | `bool` | no | Opt-in pre-spend power gate (default false): when true, an UNDERPOWERED call type (its power advisory `underpowered`) becomes `not_runnable(underpowered)` and is excluded from the estimate/reservation BEFORE any budget reserve. Advisory-only by default — the run proceeds. |
| `selection_mode` | `Literal['selection', 'noninferiority']` | no | Selection mode: `selection` (default; ranked exploratory evidence, NEVER a recommendation) or `noninferiority` (incumbent-paired, migrate-eligible). |

### CallTypeConfigParams

*request shape (TypedDict)*

Call-type config body (the validated shape). On PATCH, an omitted field keeps its current value and an explicit null clears it.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_precedents_enabled` | `bool` | no | Whether the gateway serves PER-REQUEST CASE PRECEDENTS into the learned data slot for this call type — a CASE is a VIEW over the outcome ledger, retrieved fresh per request (contrastive corrected-failure + success exemplars, ≤ 300 tokens, never an instruction). Default false (the case path is inert; serving byte-identical). Turning this on by default for customers is gated on internal validation, not on this flag. Omitted ⇒ the current value is preserved. |
| `compression_mode` | `Literal['off', 'semantic_safe', 'adaptive', 'lossless', 'auto'] \| None` | no | Compression safety tier: off (default, no model-visible rewrite), semantic_safe (deterministic, evidence-qualified) or adaptive (guarded pruning). The legacy lossless/auto values remain parseable for backward compatibility. |
| `fallbacks` | `list[str] \| None` | no | Ordered fallback model ids (OpenRouter parity). |
| `learned_context_delivery` | `Literal['gateway_inject_after_stable_prefix', 'off']` | no | Learned-context DELIVERY for this call type: gateway_inject_after_stable_prefix (default — the gateway injects the learned module after the stable prefix) or off (the gateway never injects; SDK/preflight consumers still resolve the module — off keeps the standing holdout and measurement intact, arms are still assigned and stamped). A FLIP starts a NEW learned_context epoch and invalidates any open confirmation (its baseline moved). "Inject at end" is DEFERRED (it returns behind this field once a confirmation has been run with it). Omitted ⇒ the current delivery is preserved. |
| `model_pin` | `str \| None` | no | Pinned model id for this call type (the call-type layer of the config precedence chain: request > key defaults > call type > workspace defaults > system defaults). |
| `provider_prefs` | `dict[str, Any] \| None` | no | OpenRouter-parity provider preferences object. |
| `router_mode` | `Literal['pinned', 'auto', 'candidates', 'off'] \| None` | no | Router mode for this call type. |
| `self_improve_guardrails` | `SelfImproveGuardrailsParams` | no | Autopilot guardrail config (the cost budget + enabled surfaces). Omitted ⇒ the current guardrails are preserved. |
| `self_improve_mode` | `Literal['off', 'assist', 'autopilot']` | no | Self-improve mode: off (capture outcomes only), assist (default — propose/test/push passed improvements to your inbox), or autopilot (adopt passed improvements automatically within guardrails). Omitted ⇒ the current mode is preserved. |

One server-sent `chat.completion.chunk` event.

Content chunks carry `choices`. The final chunk before `[DONE]` has empty `choices`
and carries `usage` plus the `ur` block.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `str` | yes | The completion id (the same on every chunk of a stream). |
| `object` | `str` | no | Always ``"chat.completion.chunk"``. |
| `created` | `int` | no | Unix timestamp (seconds) of the completion. |
| `model` | `str` | no | The model that produced the chunk. |
| `choices` | `list[ChunkChoice]` | no | The streamed choices (empty on the final usage chunk). |
| `usage` | `ChatCompletionUsage \| None` | no | Token usage, on the final chunk. |
| `ur` | `UrBlock \| None` | no | The ultrarouter block (request id, served model, cost, routing), on the final chunk. |
| `system_fingerprint` | `str \| None` | no | Provider system fingerprint, when reported. |

Carried to every adapter (OpenAI reasoning models require it in place of `max_tokens`; other providers map it to their own max-output field). When BOTH `max_completion_tokens` and `max_tokens` are sent, `max_completion_tokens` wins — the metered ceiling equals the cap actually sent. |

| `reasoning_effort` | `Literal['none', 'minimal', 'low', 'medium', 'high']` | no | The OpenAI reasoning-effort control, carried to every adapter. Forwarded verbatim to OpenAI-compatible providers (OpenAI reasoning models honour it; it also decides whether sampling parameters such as `temperature` are forwarded to those models); MAPPED to a thinking-token budget for budget-based providers (Anthropic / Gemini / Bedrock-Anthropic per the OpenRouter reference); refused with a NAMED `capability_unsupported` error where a provider has no reasoning knob — never silently dropped. The structured `reasoning` object takes precedence when both are sent. |

### EvalRunSpec

*response model*

The immutable RunSpec pinning this run; null on legacy runs. A run whose stored spec FAILED its content-address integrity check renders as the integrity-refused stub (`integrity_refused: true` + `tamper_class`), NEVER as authoritative evidence.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `billing_assumptions` | `str \| None` | no |  |
| `candidates` | `list[EvalRunSpecCandidate] \| None` | no |  |
| `cost_min_savings` | `float \| None` | no | The pre-registered COST BAR: the minimum per-item cost-savings fraction a candidate must clear for its cost gate to pass, SNAPSHOTTED at enqueue. The verdict reads THIS pinned value, never the live config. Null on pre-v3 legacy specs (the cost bar arrived at RunSpec v3). |
| `hypothesis` | `EvalRunSpecHypothesis \| None` | no |  |
| `incumbent` | `EvalRunSpecCandidate \| None` | no | A resolved offer identity + price snapshot (the alias resolved at enqueue). |
| `integrity_refused` | `bool` | yes | Always false on a verified RunSpec (the integrity-refused stub carries true). |
| `item_count` | `int \| None` | no | The number of frozen golden items. |
| `margin_pp` | `float \| None` | no | The pre-registered non-inferiority margin Δ (pp). |
| `population_weights` | `str \| None` | no |  |
| `profile` | `EvalRunSpecProfile \| None` | no | The immutable ExecutionProfile. |
| `profile_hash` | `str` | yes | The ExecutionProfile content hash. |
| `run_spec_id` | `str` | yes | The immutable RunSpec id (`rspec_…`). |
| `seed` | `int \| None` | no | The deterministic seed pinned into the run. |
| `spec_hash` | `str` | yes | The run-spec content hash (the dedupe key). |
| `spec_version` | `int \| None` | no |  |
| `stage` | `str \| None` | no |  |
| `task_clusters` | `str \| None` | no |  |
| `tamper_class` | `str \| None` | no | The machine-readable observed drift: `spec_version` (nulled/lowered specVersion) \| `hash_mismatch` (a pinned component was edited) \| `malformed` (a structurally broken spec — a nulled evaluator suite / deleted items / deleted candidates / a non-object spec). |

### ImportCreateParams

*request shape (TypedDict)*

Create or resume a history import (consent-gated; owner/admin or outcomes:write).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `call_type_id` | `str` | no | The call type (a `ct_*` id from `GET /v1/call-types`) this history belongs to, and so its CONFIRMED objective. Intact traces only. Every accepted record’s artifact is stamped with the call type, its confirmed objective version and its situation at assembly (insert-only), so the batch’s task verdicts count toward that call type’s readiness once a blind ADMISSION audit of the batch passes. Refused by name: an unknown call type (404 `call_type_not_found`), one without a confirmed objective (409 `call_type_unconfirmed`), a usage-only file (400 `binding_requires_intact_trace`), a resume naming another call type or binding an unbound batch (409 `binding_conflict`), a resume after the confirmed objective changed (409 `binding_stale`). Omitted on a resume ⇒ the batch keeps the binding it was created with; omitted on a new import ⇒ an UNBOUND batch whose verdicts never count toward readiness. |
| `format` | `Required[str]` | no | The pinned adapter format id (e.g. `usage_summary`, `openai_chat_jsonl`). |
| `format_version` | `str` | no | The pinned adapter version (defaults to the latest for the format). |
| `import_id` | `str` | no | Resume an existing import (idempotent per record content hash). |
| `jsonl` | `str` | no | The uploaded records as JSONL (newline-delimited JSON). Alternative to `records`. |
| `mode` | `Literal['preview', 'commit']` | no | preview = capability report only (nothing stored); commit = ingest. Defaults to commit. |
| `records` | `list[Any]` | no | The uploaded records (array form). Intact-trace records may carry request/response bodies — the ONLY import field that does; stored ONLY under corrections_consent, redacted on ingest. |

### OracleRegisterParams

*request shape (TypedDict)*

Register a check (a platform-evaluated kind, or a push / pull check you host).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `Required[Literal['label_set', 'schema_rules', 'test_endpoint', 'reconciliation', 'customer_ci']]` | no | `label_set` / `schema_rules` = platform checks (in-process, no egress); `test_endpoint` = a PUSH endpoint; `reconciliation` = push or pull; `customer_ci` = a PULL harness. |
| `oracle_id` | `str` | no | Append a new VERSION of this workspace’s existing oracle (same kind + transport). Absent ⇒ a new `orc_` id. |
| `spec` | `Required[dict[str, Any]]` | no | The check definition (strict — an unknown key is refused). `label_set`: `{labels[], field?, case_insensitive?}`. `schema_rules`: `{schema, rules[]}` (rules over `equals \| within_tolerance \| ge \| le`). Push (`test_endpoint` / push `reconciliation`): `{url, contract_version}` — the URL must pass the SSRF egress guard (https; never a private / metadata / link-local host). Pull `reconciliation`: `{contract_version}`. `customer_ci`: `{harness_identity}`. The VERSION is the sha256 of the canonical definition: a new spec is a new version (its qualification starts from nothing). |
| `transport` | `Literal['platform', 'push', 'pull']` | no | Default: the kind’s first transport. |

### PreflightParams

*request shape (TypedDict)*

Preflight request — a call type + an OPTIONAL cluster key (artifact_key | trace_id) + budget + the OPTIONAL messages a per-request case module is rendered for.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `messages` | `list[ChatMessageParam]` | no | The messages the non-proxied call is about to send. Used ONLY when the learned module is a per-request CASE module (a classification call type learns verified cases, not a static list): the gateway renders the verified cases nearest THIS input (the last user message) — exactly what the chat path would inject for the same messages. Never stored, never logged. Omitted for a case module ⇒ `knowledge: null` with `knowledge_reason: "case_query_missing"`; a static module ignores it. |
| `trace_id` | `str` | no | The trace-id cluster key (alternative to `artifact_key`; supply it to receive a grant). |

### UrParams

*request shape (TypedDict)*

ultrarouter per-request controls.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `artifact` | `str` | no | The DECLARED artifact key this request contributes to (pre-dispatch assembly). Binds the served request to the artifact (`assembly_source=declared_request`) and is the standing-holdout cluster key; the response `ur.artifact_id` echoes the bound id. Equivalent to the `X-UR-Artifact` header; the body wins on conflict. |
| `bench` | `str \| BenchTagParam` | no | ultrarouter Bench capture activation. |
| `context_modules` | `list[ContextModuleRefParam]` | no | The ordered `profile.contextModules[]` this call opts into — the `learned_context` lever surface. Each entry pins a module id AND its exact version (a retrieval-backed version IS its recipe hash), so a pack change or a ranker refit can never be served under an old pin. The gateway rebuilds the pack from the pinned recipe, refuses fail-closed on any mismatch, and SKIPS injection entirely for a holdout request. |
| `manifest` | `ManifestWireParam` | no | Declared context manifest (`toWire(manifest)`); the gateway witnesses it (verifies every hash against the received bytes before any transform) and drives compression eligibility from the declared kinds. |
| `max_cost_usd` | `float` | no |  |
| `prompt_vars` | `dict[str, str \| float \| bool]` | no | The values for the ACTIVE hosted prompt’s `{{name}}` variables, when the gateway applies a hosted prompt for this call type (`gateway_apply`). A missing REQUIRED variable is a named `prompt_variables_missing` refusal (never a silent blank). Ignored when no hosted prompt is applied. |
| `segments` | `list[SegmentHintParam]` | no | SDK segment-part labels to refine compression segmentation. |
| `tags` | `dict[str, str]` | no |  |
| `timeout_ms` | `int` | no |  |
| `trace_id` | `str` | no |  |
